interpretations: For each event status, report the unrounded average of `budget.amount - budget.spent` across matching budget lines with `spent > 6.0`, ignoring lines with a missing `amount` in the average, and count all qualifying budget lines; show a blank average if none have an `amount`.
queries:
SELECT
    e.status,
    COALESCE(AVG(b.amount - b.spent), '') AS average_remaining,
    COUNT(b.budget_id) AS budget_line_count
FROM event AS e
LEFT JOIN budget AS b
    ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id
   AND b.spent > 6.0
GROUP BY e.status
